scripts.lint: vp run @qntx/wallet-engine#build && vp run @qntx/playground#build && vp check && bun scripts/check-version.ts && bun scripts/check-cycles.ts && bun scripts/build-provider.ts --check
scripts.typecheck: vp run @qntx/wallet-engine#build && vp run @qntx/playground#build && vp run --concurrency-limit 1 -r typecheck && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: vp run @qntx/wallet-engine#build && vp run @qntx/playground#build && vp run --concurrency-limit 1 -r test
scripts.test:coverage: vp run @qntx/wallet-engine#build && vp run @qntx/playground#build && vp run --concurrency-limit 1 -r test:coverage
scripts.test:browser: vp run @qntx/wallet-engine#build && vp run @qntx/playground#build && vp run @qntx/wallet-engine#test:browser && vp run @qntx/wallet-worker#test:browser && vp run @qntx/playground#test:browser
scripts.check:pkg: bun scripts/check-links.ts && vp run @qntx/wallet#check:pkg && vp run @qntx/wallet-worker#check:pkg && vp run @qntx/wallet-engine#check:pkg && vp run @qntx/wallet-chains#check:pkg && vp run @qntx/wallet-native#check:pkg
scripts.smoke:hermes: bun run --cwd packages/wallet-worker smoke:hermes && bun run --cwd packages/wallet-chains smoke:hermes
scripts.native:host-test: vp run @qntx/wallet#build && vp run @qntx/wallet-worker#build && bun scripts/native-host-test.ts
scripts.test:consumer: vp run @qntx/wallet#build && vp run @qntx/wallet-worker#build && vp run @qntx/wallet-worker#test:consumer
scripts.native:kernel: vp run @qntx/wallet#build && vp run @qntx/wallet-worker#build && bun scripts/build-kernel.ts
